rule: Counted budget fill: standard rooms are generated until a slot budget is used; large and giant rooms cost more slots. Room class is a depth-banded weight row. Mob count per floor is a base plus depth-mod plus jitter, with a larger count on large floors. Rotation: counted family slots per depth, plus rare adds at listed depths, plus per-slot alt swaps, then shuffle. Placement avoids a safe radius around the entrance. Variety queues: a per-run shuffled queue, picked with weights 6:3:1 (front, next, after), chosen item moves to the back. Secret budget: a base per five-floor band spread over remaining floors with probabilistic rounding. Champion roll always consumes the same random calls. Patch generator: seeded fill, clustering passes, optional forced fill rate.
keep: counted, shuffled family rotation with rare adds and alt swaps
front-biased variety queue (6:3:1) that moves the picked item to the back
safe radius around the entrance with no spawns
champion roll with constant random-call count (seed discipline)
change: cap total attempts in the mob placement loop (RegularLevel.java 255-299)
cap iterations in the Patch forced-fill loop (Patch.java)
seed rotations and champion rolls from zone seed on the server
names, families, room classes, numbers and art are ours
look_test: Six 375-wide stills to /preview/ (no release rows), one zone seed: a floor with the safe ring drawn; a four-slot family strip for three depth tiers; one enemy with and without a champion modifier at two frequencies. Dom judges whether each room reads from the doorway and whether the first room feels safe.
